categories.A: Central token definitions; component UI colors should refer to semantic tokens.
categories.B: Contextual intentional/inherited exception candidates; not evidence of an error.
categories.C: Remaining literal requiring contextual review; not automatically a bug.
categories.D: Confirmed theme defects are enumerated with before/after evidence in docs/ui-ux-audit-2026-11-20.md, rather than inferred from this lexical scan.

limitations: Lexical inventory only. CSS selector context is a best-effort clue. Images, remote official-login pages and OS-owned dialogs are not recolored or certified by this scan.
